proposals_not_done.reason: Needs the shared core LIGHT file fetcher (P269 c2: no module writes its own; not built). The core binds every ctx.http request of a LIGHT module to the seed, so the archive discovery is delivered as a PASSIVE module (cond 1) and live URLs are listed, never fetched. Backlog: docs/backlog/p9-G13-3.md.

core_requests: Shared LIGHT file fetcher (P269 c2/P287 c4): fetch analyst-typed document URLs (--mode light, <= 10 docs, <= 10 MB each, <= 20 MB total, 1 req/s, P270 checks) and hand files to document_metadata; public_docs_discovery.aggregate_doc_metadata() can aggregate the results.
v3lum.core.sandbox (P269 c5): public_docs_discovery.parse_document parses archived copies in process with the P269 functions until it lands.
CLI: per-run interactive confirmation listing port_scan targets (non-TTY refuses, P286 c2) and a --wordlist flag mapped onto setting path_discovery_wordlist (P285 c4).
Scope schema: a limit allowing more than one host or a /29 per port-scan run (P286 c4 'unless the scope file allows more'); port_scan refuses larger ranges today.
Doctor / run banner warning when proxy_active is not configured (P286 c8); the module records the egress in port_scan.egress.

notes: P285 path_discovery: ACTIVE, run_on seeds + applies() refuses pivots/extracted values; GET only via ctx.http (scope/SSRF/egress/ceilings/ledger in core), max_rate 10, SecLists lists at 5 req/s (per-call min_interval), stops the host at the first 429/challenge/WAF/proxy answer, tri-state per path; default list = 41 V3LUM-authored paths (<= 50) pinned by SHA-256 in DEFAULT_LIST_SHA256; 7 SecLists lists registered as active datasets pinned at commit 01bd31a9 (active_locks), over-cap lists refused; actuator dump endpoints recorded from the index, never requested (actuator index read up to 8 KB, every other path 1 KB - interpretation in the backlog). The core never follows a redirect to a login page (login_wall), which matches cond 3. P286 port_scan: ACTIVE, ctx.net.connect only (2 worker threads, connector enforces 10/s, 2/host, 1000 ports, kill switch), IP/CIDR <= /29 only (domains refused: cond 2), top-100 own order (ICS excluded) or explicit <= 1000 ports, banners read-only <= 1 KB in <= 3 s for server-first roles, software_hints without CVEs, egress-suspect heuristic for uniform local RSTs. P287 public_docs_discovery: PASSIVE third_party (council opsec 'light' covers the download step, which belongs to the core LIGHT fetcher - see proposals_not_done); Wayback CDX + Common Crawl first, archive copies only (Wayback id_ or CC WARC Range), Brave (brave_search.web) only when both archives found nothing, seed/own domains, one query, ttl 0, URL+title; token URLs never fetched nor pivoted; names/usernames only for verified own or in-scope domains (<= 5 samples, expand=False). Provider brave_search.json created (host api.search.brave.com mapped to null in owners.json); github__p9-G13-3.json and commoncrawl__p9-G13-3.json extend existing providers; internet_archive.wayback and commoncrawl.cdx_index reused. Failures seen in the shared suite belong to other batches in flight (js_endpoints_*, site_contacts*, tls_protocol_scan contract rows; dns_bruteforce/nuclei_runner notice fragments; github__p9-G03-2 registry error). Review (adversarial, 2026-11-26): fixed path_discovery swallowing the run deadline (DeadlineExceeded is a NetworkError: the loop kept going and the result was neither partial nor timed out) and OfflineError; a host whose random paths answer 401 or redirect to a login page now yields 'could not test' (BLOCKED login_wall when nothing is confirmed) instead of 41 'not observed'; status-only differences pivot at 'possible'. port_scan: RTT from the connector ledger (pacing excluded), no-answer hosts (all filtered/unreachable) end ERROR timeout instead of OK, banner dicts no longer leak into the attribute and a stopped scan keeps its partial summary/pivots, IPv4 network/broadcast addresses of a /29 are skipped. public_docs_discovery: EMPTY only when both archives answered (Wayback failure + CC empty was EMPTY), Common Crawl error-in-200 / empty body / non-'No Captures' 404 are errors, offline -> UNAVAILABLE offline, deadline -> timeout. New tests prove each fix (each fails on the pre-fix code), plus the SecLists wordlist path end to end at 5 req/s and 'not installed -> UNAVAILABLE dataset, never fetched mid-run'. Shared-suite failures outside the batch: other in-flight batches' contract rows (missing tests), leak_lookup_public P327 lint, and tests/safety socks cases (PySocks not installed in this environment).
